name: Avgust
bio: Archetype: AoE HoT, Lineup-Based Buffs. ⌽ Skill 1 deals damage, Dispels buffs, and grants DMG Bonus to units in front. ⌽ Skill 2 heals and grants DMG heal to units behind. ⌽ Insight I passively grants DMG Bonus to those in front and DMG heal to those behind. ⌽ Gain ATK bonus for each ally in front, and DMG taken reduction for each ally behind. ⌽ Placement in the team lineup should be adjusted to be in front when defense is needed and behind when offense is needed.
